newsitem.title: GERMANY: Big dividends planned for Deutsche Telekom share.
newsitem.headline: Big dividends planned for Deutsche Telekom share.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom's share issue next month, set to be Europe's largest-ever stock offering, could go on the block for 25 German marks ($16.35) a share and will be sweetened with promises of big dividends, analysts' reports said Wednesday.

The huge 15 billion mark ($9.8 billion) initial public offering (IPO) will transform the telecommunications company overnight into the most heavily-weighted stock on Frankfurt's DAX index of 30 blue-chip stocks.
Analysts' reports that have begun to trickle out to the press portrayed Deutsche Telekom as an investment with some short-term risks but one that could be quite profitable over time.
"The Telekom share represents an interesting investment opportunity for long-term and risk-conscious investors," concluded Helaba Trust in a report obtained by Reuters.
Hoping to smooth over apparent risks, DT has said it will pay 1.5 billion marks ($980 million) in dividends for 1996 and plans to announce on Friday the amount it will pay for 1997.
